findings.title: Self-Trace Assessment Input Lacks Explicit Not_Assessed Gaps Enumeration
findings.evidence: assessment-input.json already contains a top-level not_assessed array. It now explicitly includes immutable_source_commit, external_attestation, and fresh_checkout_validation.

findings.title: Crisis Socratic Review Artifact Reference Ambiguity
findings.evidence: Crisis Kimi critic, GLM critic, and MiniMax judge artifacts are recorded as review evidence events with external_ref and SHA-256 artifact digests; provenance-records.json records pi provider/model/tool metadata. self-trace-v0-summary.md now calls this out explicitly.

findings.title: Negative Native Policy Field Validation Coverage Gap
findings.evidence: validate-self-trace.sh now recursively rejects native policy keys in assessment-input.json and trace-snapshot.json, while still allowing external verdict input fields.

findings.title: Human-Held Escalation Path Lacks Timestamped Acknowledgment
findings.evidence: The accountability node now records DRI, approver, risk owner, escalation, an escalation_trigger_condition, and last_human_acknowledgment as not_assessed because no timestamped human acknowledgment artifact is committed.

findings.title: Metric Stream Missing Fresh Checkout Isolation Evidence
findings.evidence: fresh_checkout_validation is recorded as not_assessed in metric-stream and assessment input because the current evidence was reproduced in the shared worktree, not a fresh checkout.

secondary_review.note: Read-only tool review produced no payload before timeout.
